title: Authoritative scripted-locomotion protocol loading
problem: Post-E69 scripted locomotion executes a 160 cm/s, 1.0/1.6/2.1/2.4/3.0 second schedule while manifests declare locked scripted-locomotion.v1, whose authoritative values are 60 cm/s and 1.0/2.0/4.0/5.0/6.0 seconds. The fixture copies a protocol path but does not load or enforce the file.
single_change: Introduce a pure versioned protocol parser/resolver, create scripted-locomotion.v2.json for the E69 schedule, and make the fixture load schedule, fixed timestep, map, capture duration, and acceptance thresholds from the selected protocol before PIE. Emit the exact protocol SHA-256 and resolved protocol fields in evidence.
locked_invariants: No Pose Search, policy, Physics Control, Chaos, frame conversion, gain, or action behavior changes
A missing, malformed, unlocked, or internally inconsistent protocol invalidates the run before PIE
Runtime phase resolution and nominal speed are derived only from the loaded protocol object
Manifest protocol_path, protocol_sha256, protocol_id, protocol_version, and resolved script values match the loaded bytes
tdd_red: v1 loader returns its original 60 cm/s and 1.0/2.0/4.0/5.0/6.0 boundaries
v2 loader returns 160 cm/s and 1.0/1.6/2.1/2.4/3.0 boundaries
phase resolver uses the loaded protocol rather than compile-time constants
malformed or non-LOCKED protocols fail validation
fixture configuration selects v2 and exposes its loaded hash and schedule
acceptance: Existing scripted schedule test passes using loaded v2
A product evidence manifest identifies v2 and contains its actual SHA-256 and resolved schedule
No runtime schedule constant remains in PhysAnimCausalStanding.Tests.cpp
